title: Compare letter counts in a 26-slot array
invariant: After adding all letters of the first string and removing a prefix of the second, counts[i] is the first string’s frequency of letter i minus that prefix’s frequency. A negative count proves the second string needs more of that letter than the first contains. If the strings have equal length and no bucket becomes negative, all buckets finish at zero.

frames.explanation: All 26 buckets begin at zero. A bucket will hold letters added from the first string minus letters removed by the second.
